name: valyria-app
description: Valyria — a branded Code-OSS distribution with the Valyria autonomous agent as a built-in extension. This root hosts the npm workspace (extension, packages/*, apps/*) and the Cargo workspace (Cargo.toml). The editor itself is the `vscode/` submodule; see docs/ARCHITECTURE-VSCODE.md.
//workspaces: extension/ is intentionally NOT a workspace — it's a self-contained built-in extension with its own lockfile, symlinked into vscode/extensions/ at bootstrap. Keeping it out of the root workspace avoids npm hoisting its @types/vscode into a tree the Code-OSS build also scans.
